verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no officially published, maintained SDK for Open Finance. The GitHub repository only describes generating a client library yourself from the OpenAPI specification. That is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit. The MCP toolkit's code generation is a separate, adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The test project generates an API client library from the API specification like you would do in a real application
